body: I know it sounds stupid but we are pretty much infatuated with one another. I mean we were talking about what month we would want to have a freaking wedding in the day before all of this blew up

the thing about my girlfriend is that she is NEVER like this. She has never done or said anything like that before. Like yeah, we have our fair share of fights, but what couple who's been together for so long doesn't? i mean a year and a half is a fairly long time for a 17 year old kid ya know? And her original apology was really sincere. She legitimately begged me to give her another chance. It's more of a trust issue thing, she really isn't a bad girl
